title: External EyeSight Display Not Working
shortDescription: Front lenticular display does not show eyes.
fullDescription: EyeSight may not display if Personas are disabled or if the device is in Travel Mode. Check Settings and recalibrate eyes.

fixSteps.title: Disable Travel Mode
fixSteps.instruction: Control Center > Travel Mode toggle off.

title: Video Passthrough Stutters or Tints
shortDescription: Passthrough has color cast or freezes.
fullDescription: Passthrough issues often follow visionOS updates or in low light. Restart and ensure visionOS is current.

title: Light Leaking Around Light Seal
shortDescription: Light bleeds in around nose or cheeks.
fullDescription: Improper Light Seal size lets stray light degrade the experience. Apple offers fit kits.

fixSteps.title: Re-scan with Apple app
fixSteps.instruction: Use Apple Store fit scan to get correct size.

faq.a: Multiple sizes; Apple recommends via face scan.

title: Battery Pack Lasts Under Spec
shortDescription: Battery dies before 2 hours of use.
fullDescription: Vision Pro battery rated 2-2.5 hours. Heavy 3D content reduces it. Ensure battery is genuine and update visionOS.

fixSteps.title: Use plugged-in mode
fixSteps.instruction: Connect battery pack to USB-C 30W charger.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Apple replaces under warranty if degraded.

title: Overheat Warning Before Use
shortDescription: Headset shows cooling required.
fullDescription: Vision Pro shuts down if internal temperature too high. Wait 5-10 minutes in cool room.

fixSteps.title: Cool environment
fixSteps.instruction: Move to room under 25C, wait 10 min.

title: Eye Tracking Targets Wrong Item
shortDescription: Selection lands on wrong UI element.
fullDescription: Eye tracking inaccuracy stems from dirty inserts, misaligned ZEISS lenses, or eyelash interference.

faq.a: Use ZEISS optical inserts, not bare glasses.

title: Cannot Create Persona
shortDescription: Persona setup fails or looks wrong.
fullDescription: Persona capture requires good lighting and steady head movements. Beta status means quality varies.

fixSteps.title: Even lighting
fixSteps.instruction: Face indirect window or two diffused lamps.

fixSteps.title: Remove obstructions
fixSteps.instruction: Tie hair back, take off hat.

faq.a: Persona is in beta; quality improving with updates.

title: Mac Virtual Display Connection Fails
shortDescription: Vision Pro cannot mirror Mac.
fullDescription: Both devices must be on same iCloud account, on same Wi-Fi, with Mac awake. Bluetooth required.

fixSteps.title: Match Apple ID
fixSteps.instruction: Sign in with same Apple ID on both.

fixSteps.title: Same Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Connect both to identical SSID and band.

faq.a: Mac Virtual Display supports ultrawide single screen.

title: Guest Mode Setup Fails
shortDescription: Cannot hand off Vision Pro to friend.
fullDescription: Guest Mode requires owner to authenticate via iPhone. Without paired iPhone, Guest Mode is unavailable.

fixSteps.title: Use Mirroring
fixSteps.instruction: Mirror to iPhone or Apple TV to see what guest sees.

faq.a: Each guest can do quick re-enroll.

title: Audio Pods Silent or Lacking Spatial Effect
shortDescription: Built-in speakers do not produce spatial audio.
fullDescription: Spatial Audio requires correct head-tracking and the audio source to support it. AirPods Pro 2 with USB-C also work for personal sound.

fixSteps.title: Pair AirPods Pro 2
fixSteps.instruction: For lossless audio, use USB-C AirPods Pro 2.

faq.a: Limited; spatial works best with PRO 2 USB-C.
